name: @agentmemory/pi
description: agentmemory extension for the pi coding agent: memory recall on agent start, capture on agent end, memory_search / memory_save / memory_health tools, /agentmemory-status command

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for(const p of ['dist/index.mjs','skills/remember/SKILL.md','LICENSE']) if(!fs.existsSync(p)) throw new Error('Run npm run plugin:pack:pi from the repository root first')"
